name: eq_of_mem
statement: Part α} (ha : a.Dom) (hb : a.get ha ∈ b) : a = b

name: le_total_of_le_of_le
statement: Part α} (z : Part α) (hx : x ≤ z) (hy : y ≤ z) : x ≤ y ∨ y ≤ x

have_tree.name: hx
have_tree.body: hx _ h₀; have hy := hy _ h₁

name: bind_le
statement: Part α) (f : α → Part β) (y : Part β) : x >>= f ≤ y ↔ ∀ a, a ∈ x → f a ≤ y
